paper.title: Petition style changes with AI writing support but outcomes do not improve
paper.abstract: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02579-1 In 2023, Change.org introduced an artificial intelligence (AI)-supported petition-drafting tool to their platform. With access to this tool, users’ petitions changed substantially, and their texts became more similar to one another. At the same time, overall petition outcomes did not improve, which shows the limits of AI integration into online advocacy communities.

script.description_zh: 2023年,連署平台Change.org推出AI請願草擬工具。研究發現,使用者能用這個工具後,請願文字明顯改變、彼此也越來越相似,但整體請願成效並沒有提升。AI能幫你寫,卻不一定能幫你贏。
script.description_en: In 2023, Change.org added an AI tool that helps users draft petitions. A new study in Nature Human Behaviour finds that petitions changed substantially and became more similar to each other once users had the tool, yet overall outcomes did not improve. AI can change how advocacy sounds without changing what it achieves.
script.method_summary: The study examined Change.org, an online petition platform that introduced an AI-supported petition-drafting tool in 2023. The researchers compared petitions written by users with access to this tool against petitions written without it (around the tool's introduction), using computational text analysis to measure how petition texts changed and how similar petitions were to one another. They also compared petition outcomes. According to the published abstract, two main findings emerged: first, with access to the AI tool, users' petitions changed substantially and their texts became more similar to one another (a homogenizing effect on writing). Second, overall petition outcomes did not improve. The authors interpret this as showing the limits of integrating AI into online advocacy communities: AI writing support altered style and reduced diversity of texts, but did not translate into better results for petitioners on the whole. The abstract does not specify the sample size, the exact outcome measures, the specific text-similarity method, or effect sizes, so these details were not reported in this episode.
script.limitations: Based on the abstract alone, exact sample size, outcome metrics, and effect sizes are not stated, so no numbers were reported. The study covers a single platform, Change.org, so results may not generalize to other platforms, countries, or forms of advocacy. 'Outcomes did not improve' refers to overall results; it does not show that AI never helps an individual petition, nor does it fully explain why outcomes stayed flat (e.g., whether homogenized texts cancel each other out). Design details limiting causal claims are not described in the abstract.

pt.title: IA escreveu o abaixo-assinado. Ele ganhou mais?
pt.paper_title: Ferramentas de IA mudam a escrita de petições online, mas não seus resultados
pt.description: Em 2023, a Change.org lançou uma ferramenta de IA que ajuda os usuários a redigir abaixo-assinados. Um novo estudo na Nature Human Behaviour mostra que, com a ferramenta, os textos mudaram bastante e ficaram mais parecidos entre si, mas os resultados gerais não melhoraram. A IA pode mudar o jeito como o ativismo soa, sem mudar o que ele conquista.

scenes.heading: A PERGUNTA
scenes.big_text: Petição feita por IA vai melhor?
lines: Se a IA te ajuda a escrever um abaixo-assinado, ele vai se sair melhor?

scenes.heading: O ESTUDO
lines: Esse estudo saiu na revista Nature Human Behaviour.

scenes.heading: OS DADOS
lines: Em 2023, a Change.org lançou uma IA que redige abaixo-assinados.
Os pesquisadores analisaram as petições que os usuários escreveram lá.

scenes.heading: ANTES E DEPOIS
lines: Eles compararam petições de antes e depois de o usuário ter a ferramenta.
Um computador mediu como as palavras e o estilo mudaram.

scenes.heading: SEMELHANÇA
lines: Depois, mediram o quanto as petições se pareciam umas com as outras.
Os textos mudaram muito e começaram a soar iguais.

scenes.heading: RESULTADOS
scenes.big_text: O estilo mudou. O resultado, não.
lines: Mas, no geral, os resultados das petições não melhoraram.
Um porém: isso é só uma plataforma.
E não quer dizer que a IA nunca ajude nenhuma petição.

scenes.heading: CONCLUSÃO
scenes.big_text: Texto bonito não é texto poderoso
lines: A IA pode mudar suas palavras, mas não necessariamente o resultado.

lines.zh: 奴役勞工被抓，牧場就收手了嗎？

lines.zh: 數百萬筆牛隻交易，揭穿他們怎麼繞路。

lines.en: They analyzed millions of cattle transaction records in Brazil.

lines.en: The result: operators didn't stop, they adapted.

script.description_zh: 巴西有些養牛牧場被查出奴役勞工，政府和企業紛紛制裁。但制裁之後業者怎麼反應，過去幾乎沒有證據。這篇PNAS研究用數百萬筆牛隻交易紀錄補上這塊空白，發現業者不是收手，而是以「洗白」和「規避」換方式繼續。
script.description_en: Some ranches in Brazil's cattle industry were caught using slave labor, and governments and companies moved to sanction them. But there has been almost no evidence on how sanctioned operators actually respond. This PNAS study fills that gap with millions of cattle transaction records, documenting laundering and evasion instead of simply stopping.
script.method_summary: The study (Mittelberg, Skidmore, Brandão, Rausch and Gibbs; University of Wisconsin–Madison and University of Illinois; PNAS 2026) asks how perpetrators of modern slavery in Brazil's cattle sector change their behavior after antislavery sanctions. Its key contribution: governments and companies have worked to rid supply chains of modern slavery, but little was known about policy outcomes, especially how perpetrators respond to sanctions. The authors use data on millions of cattle transactions in Brazil, which record cattle moving between properties and buyers, effectively forming a network of cattle flows. They examine the transactions of operators sanctioned under antislavery policies and how their selling behavior changes in response. The paper's title identifies two behavioral responses: laundering (making cattle linked to sanctioned operators appear clean as they move through the supply chain) and evasion (adjusting behavior to avoid the consequences of sanctions). The core message is that sanctioned actors adapt rather than simply stopping, which matters for designing supply-chain monitoring. Only the abstract's opening was available to us, so specific effect sizes, sample counts, the exact identification strategy, and how prevalent each response is were not provided and are not stated in the video.
script.limitations: We only had a truncated abstract, so the video gives no effect sizes or prevalence figures. Transaction records only capture recorded sales; informal or unrecorded movements of cattle are invisible. The analysis is observational, so behavior changes are associated with sanctions rather than proven to be solely caused by them. The study focuses on Brazil's cattle sector and may not generalize to other countries or commodities, and it does not show which policy fixes would work best.

pt.title: Flagradas com trabalho escravo: as fazendas param?
pt.paper_title: Como produtores punidos por trabalho escravo reagem na cadeia do gado no Brasil
pt.description: Algumas fazendas da pecuária brasileira foram flagradas com trabalho escravo, e governo e empresas reagiram com punições. Mas quase não havia evidência de como esses produtores reagem depois. Esse é o grande diferencial deste estudo publicado na PNAS: com milhões de registros de venda de gado, ele mostra lavagem e evasão, em vez de simplesmente parar.

lines: Flagradas com trabalho escravo, fazendas param?

scenes.heading: O ESTUDO
lines: Uma equipe da Universidade de Wisconsin–Madison publicou isso na PNAS.

scenes.heading: O CONTEXTO
lines: Algumas fazendas no Brasil foram flagradas com trabalho escravo.
O governo pune, e as empresas tentam evitar essas fazendas.

scenes.heading: POR QUE IMPORTA
lines: Mas como esses produtores reagem depois da punição
quase não tinha evidência nenhuma.
E é aí que está o trunfo do estudo: preencher essa lacuna.

scenes.heading: OS DADOS
lines: Eles analisaram milhões de registros de venda de gado no Brasil.
Cada um mostra quem vendeu gado pra quem, formando uma rede.

scenes.heading: O MÉTODO
lines: Rastrearam pra onde ia o gado dos produtores punidos.
E compararam as vendas antes e depois da punição.

scenes.heading: A DESCOBERTA
lines: Resultado: os produtores não pararam, eles se adaptaram.
Lavagem: fazer o gado problemático parecer limpo.

Mas vendas por fora dos registros não aparecem nos dados.
